description: Delete a project (removes GitHub repo, K8s deployments, and database). It runs as a job: poll the returned job_id with get_job_status until it is completed. One operation runs on a project at a time: while another runs, the call is refused and the refusal names the running job; wait for it with get_job_status, then call again. While RationalBloks is being updated, the call is refused with 'RationalBloks is being updated': call it again in a few minutes.
name: delete_project
title: Delete Project
